title: Shapley Value Lies In The Core Of A Convex Game
body_html:
Shapley Value Lies In The Core Of A Convex Game

Theorem. If a TU game is convex, then its Shapley value belongs to the core.

Convexity means marginal contributions are increasing with coalition size. This increasing-marginal-returns property makes the Shapley average satisfy every coalitional rationality inequality: $$ \sum_{i \in S}\operatorname{Sh}_i(v) \ge v(S) \quad\text{for every } S \subseteq N. $$ Together with Shapley efficiency, this places the Shapley payoff vector in the core.

Lean Status

The Lean module defines the Shapley value and core predicates. This theorem remains a blueprint target.

References

  • [MSZ Ch.18, Thm 18.32] Maschler, Solan, Zamir, Game Theory.
